expected_level_description: You can: - identify and register incidents, gathering the required information and allocating it to the appropriate channel
You can: - collate data from data repositories and provide basic reporting - explain what a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is and why it is important
You can: - show an awareness of problem resolution processes - pass problems on to your team

You can: - investigate problems in systems, processes and services, with an understanding of the level of a problem, for example, strategic, tactical or operational - contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures
You can: - show an awareness or understanding of user experience analysis and its principles - explain the purpose of user stories and the focus on user needs
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - follow access rules and protect your credentials
You can: - follow health and safety rules and report hazards and incidents
